reason: Before any SRM analysis result was computed, the first workflow stopped at the data-integrity gate. Direct unversioned S3 path retrieval returned the correct byte length but bytes that did not match the frozen OpenNeuro v1.2.1 git-annex MD5E identity. A diagnostic run then established that openneuro-py 2026.7.1, OpenNeuro's public client, retrieved the exact frozen annex object for sub-001 (expected MD5 a4aa13370458a970886967bd6dc6d672), whereas the direct S3 path returned MD5 ae9af95435bf92095ad6d09257388c38. No v0.7 metric, surrogate, endpoint or subject result had been computed at that point.
superseded_data_transport_clause: Direct unversioned S3 path retrieval is not used for this validation because it did not reproduce the frozen snapshot annex identity.

corrected_data_transport_clause.selection: download only the preregistered subject EDF path plus client-required BIDS metadata
corrected_data_transport_clause.post_download_integrity: The downloaded EDF must exactly match both the byte size and MD5 stored in V07_SRM_DUAL_NULL_DATASET_MANIFEST.json, whose values were extracted from the git-annex MD5E keys at OpenNeuro tag 1.2.1 / commit cb354b249827d17fa0575b2b42521ba25982c16b. Analysis is forbidden on mismatch.
